text:
sara: quick heads-up — weird token/sentinel bleed during HF->Redwood chat_template conversion when onboarding new model (gpt-ish). Repro below.

sara: raw HF template:
```jinja
{% for m in conversation %}
<|{{ m.role }}|>{{ m.content }}
{% endfor %}
```

sara: rendered prompt (after our jinja pre-render):
```text
<|system|>You are helpful.
<|user|>Explain X.
<|assistant|>Sure — here's ...
```

oliver: rendered looks ok, what's bleeding?

sara: tokenizer splits '<|' and '|>' into separate tokens on this model tokenizer. After tokenization we get partial sentinels attached to content like '\n<|assistant' as tokens, which shifts KV-cache alignment and causes role tokens to be baked into generation. Config snippet:
```json
{
  "bos_token": "",
  "eos_token": "",
  "additional_special_tokens": ["<|system|>", "<|user|>", "<|assistant|>"]
}
```

maya: sounds like special_tokens_map not being applied before tokenization in our HF->RW conversion path. Do we add tokens to tokenizer then save? If not, the tokenizer will byte-level split the markers.

dan: also saw this when we quantized the model (q4_0 vs q4_f16). KV cache offsets change slightly and our prompt slicing assumed sentinel token boundaries by char index rather than token index. That mismatch + broken special tokens = hallucinated role text.

alex (qa-bot): eval/eod/nightly failed: delta-rouge:-3.9%, failures on the 'role-preservation' prompt set.

deploy-bot: ci/onboard-187 failed: 'prompt-rendering-check' (exit 1)

oliver: temporary workaround — replace angle sentinels with ascii-safe bracket marker during pre-render, e.g. '[[SYSTEM]]' etc, then map back in runtime. That avoids tokenizer splitting.

maya: longer term: add a step in hf->redwood conversion to (1) load tokenizer, (2) add additional_special_tokens, (3) call tokenizer.save_pretrained() with updated tokens, then render. Also add unit test that tokenizes the rendered prompt and asserts sentinel tokens are single tokens.

sara: thanks — I'll draft a small repro and add tests. Patch TBD, will also re-run quantized evals on q4_f16 and q8_0 to compare.

dan: note: for quant regressions, include 'float16 vs int4' doc in PR — we need bit-exact seed and prompt set.

sara: ok creating branch onboarding/sentinel-preserve-174999. Will ping when ready :thumbsup: 

oliver: nice. add a short checklist item in model-onboard.md: 'validate special token preservation + token-indexed role-slicing'

sara: done (will push after CI passes)
